summary: Operational installation guide describing what the shipped installer does: prerequisites it checks, release artifacts, upgrade, prepare-migrate-activate for an incompatible store migration, the maintenance boundary that excludes session admission across the final lease check, migration, and activation, repair, and uninstall behavior. Descriptive, not prescriptive — the installer's behavior is proved by scripts/test-installer.py and the release pipeline, so under the procedure's prescription rule the document is reference material, not law.
title: Installing Concord
